tests.instructions: One assessment per chapter grouping plus a final exam. Every question maps to the section shown in brackets so you can revise precisely.

questions.q: Which concept makes g++ behave that way? (C++ ch.1)
The worked sample prints "Hello, C++20". Which statement caused it? (ch.1)
Which concept makes int behave that way? (C++ ch.2)
The worked sample prints "8". Which statement caused it? (ch.2)
Which concept makes & behave that way? (C++ ch.3)
The worked sample prints "Values are swapped in place". Which statement caused it? (ch.3)
Which concept makes constructor behave that way? (C++ ch.4)
The worked sample prints "cleaned printed on scope exit". Which statement caused it? (ch.4)
Which concept makes template behave that way? (C++ ch.5)
The worked sample prints "1 2 3". Which statement caused it? (ch.5)
Which concept makes std::move behave that way? (C++ ch.6)
The worked sample prints "Move avoids a second allocation". Which statement caused it? (ch.6)
Which concept makes auto behave that way? (C++ ch.7)
The worked sample prints "42". Which statement caused it? (ch.7)

assessment.q: Write C++ code that reads a value, transforms it and prints the result. (final)
